topPRs.title: ci: drop circleci_ip_ranges flag, migrate to circleci-repo-rpc-secrets context
topPRs.author: hdcesario-op
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Remove `circleci_ip_ranges: true` from the six jobs that set it in
`.circleci/config.yml` and migrate the five Tier-B jobs to the org-wide
`circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` CircleCI context
(created in ethereum-optimism/optimism#20465) for L1 RPC URLs. The sixth
job is Tier A and only loses the flag.

Part of [W3 of ethereum-optimism/core-team#2564](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/core-team/issues/2564).
Same pattern as the reference PR ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1429.

## Per-job audit

| Job def | Workflow invocation(s) | Network-wise | Tier | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `go-lint-test` | `go-lint-test-ops`, `go-lint-test-validation` | `gotestsum` runs with `SEPOLIA_RPC_URL`/`MAINNET_RPC_URL` env set to `ci-{sepolia,mainnet}-l1.optimism.io`; tests dial those endpoints | B | Drop flag; replace step-level `environment:` interpolation with shell `export` from `$OP_CI_*` (see "Why this is safe" §3); attach `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` context to both invocations |
| `run-tool` | 5 invocations; only `check-staging-synced` uses L1 URLs via the `args` parameter. The other 4 (`check-genesis-integrity`, `check-depsets`, `check-apply-hardforks`, `check-chainlist`) pass no L1 URLs | The job def was flagged for all 5, even though 4 of them never needed allowlisted access | B for `check-staging-synced` only; A for the other 4 | Drop flag at the job-def level. Rewrite the `check-staging-synced` invocation's `args` to use `$OP_CI_*` env vars and attach `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` context only there |
| `run-staging-report` | `run-staging-report` | `print_staging_report` reads same two env vars from step-level `environment:` block | B | Same migration as `go-lint-test` |
| `check-codegen` | `check-codegen` | Inline `--l1-rpc-urls="<<sepolia>>,<<mainnet>>"` to the `codegen` Go binary | B | Drop flag; swap the inline URL interpolation for `$OP_CI_*`; attach context |
| `daily-codegen` | `daily-codegen` (scheduled / API-triggered workflow) | `just codegen <<sepolia>>,<<mainnet>>` is the RPC-touching step. Other steps push to public `github.com` and a Slack webhook, neither of which needs the allowlist | B | Drop flag; swap the URL args for `$OP_CI_*`; attach context |
| `build-deployer-binaries` | `build-deployer-binaries` | Downloads pre-built op-deployer binaries from `github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/releases` (public); fallback path clones the public monorepo with `git clone --depth 1 ...optimism.git`. No allowlisted call | A | Drop flag only |

Jobs that never had the flag (`check-staging-empty`, `notify-when-chain-is-added-to-registry`) are untouched.

## Why this is safe

`circleci_ip_ranges: true` routes a job's egress through CircleCI's 21 static IPs at premium egress pricing. Inside OP Labs that allowlist is consumed by exactly one Traefik middleware (`ci-ip-whitelist` in `ethereum-optimism/k8s` at `kustomize/gke-bootstrap/components/traefik/bases/middleware.yaml`), gating the `ci-*.optimism.io` endpoints.

1. **Tier B jobs** previously dialed `ci-{sepolia,mainnet}-l1.optimism.io` for L1 access. The `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` context exposes `OP_CI_{SEPOLIA,MAINNET}_L1_RPC_URL` pointing at non-allowlisted equivalents reachable from any egress IP, so dropping the flag and switching to the env vars preserves functional access without routing through the premium egress path.

2. **`run-tool` declassification.** Four of its five invocations don't take L1 URL args and never had a reason to be IP-restricted. They were inheriting the flag from the job def. Removing the flag at the job def removes premium egress from all five, which is correct: only the one invocation (`check-staging-synced`) that uses `$OP_CI_*` needs the new context, and the others are pure Go-tool runs.

3. **`environment:` → shell `export` switch.** CircleCI's step-level `environment:` block is interpolated at config-render time, so it can't reference context env vars like `$OP_CI_*` (those only exist at runtime). The L1 URL assignments are moved into the shell command via `export ...` immediately before the invocation that needs them. Functionally identical for the spawned Go process; structurally different.

4. **Tier A (`build-deployer-binaries`).** The script `ops/internal/deployer/scripts/build-binaries.sh` reaches only public `github.com` endpoints — the release-tag URL and (on fallback) `git clone --depth 1 --branch <tag> https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism.git`. Neither is allowlisted, so the flag was a no-op for it.

## Changes

- `parameters`: drop `sepolia_rpc_url` and `mainnet_rpc_url` (now resolved from context env vars).
- `go-lint-test`, `run-staging-report`: drop `circleci_ip_ranges: true`; replace step-level `environment:` mappings with shell `export $OP_CI_* ...` statements in the run command.
- `run-tool`: drop `circleci_ip_ranges: true` at the job-def level (covers all five invocations).
- `check-codegen`: drop flag; replace inline `<< pipeline.parameters.{sepolia,mainnet}_rpc_url >>` with `$OP_CI_{SEPOLIA,MAINNET}_L1_RPC_URL`.
- `daily-codegen`: drop flag; swap the URL args for `$OP_CI_*` env vars.
- `build-deployer-binaries`: drop flag only.
- `workflows.main.jobs`: attach `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` context to `go-lint-test-ops`, `go-lint-test-validation`, `check-codegen`, `check-staging-synced`, `run-staging-report`. Convert these from single-string `context: foo` to list-form `context: [foo, bar]`. Also rewrite the `check-staging-synced` `args` to use `$OP_CI_*` env vars.
- `workflows.daily-codegen.jobs`: attach `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` context to `daily-codegen` (also list-form).

## Verification plan

- One full CI run on the draft. Watch the five migrated Tier-B jobs for 403s, timeouts, or "endpoint is empty" errors:
  - `go-lint-test-ops`, `go-lint-test-validation`
  - `check-codegen`
  - `check-staging-synced`
  - `run-staging-report`
- `daily-codegen` is a scheduled workflow; verify its next run after merge (or trigger via the `daily_codegen_dispatch` pipeline parameter).
- Confirm Tier-A jobs (`build-deployer-binaries`, the four non-URL `run-tool` invocations) still pass without the flag.

## Reviewer notes

- `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` is org-wide with no project restriction — no infra changes needed for this repo to consume it.
- After CI green, will move from draft to ready and request review.

# Chains upgraded

Following chains were upgraded recently at Alchemy:
* worldchain-mainnet (chain_id = 480) and worldchain-sepolia to upgrade 18 - hardfork activation timestamps were merged earlier, this PR just has some contract addresses updated
* boba-sepolia (chain_id = 28882) - upgraded to upgrade 18, however isthmus and jovian have not been activated so far
* shape-mainnet (chain_id = 360) and shape-sepolia (chain_id = 11011) - upgraded to upgrade 18 and activated isthmus and jovian; added also holocene timestamp for mainnet
* settlus-mainnet (chain_id = 5371) and settlus-sepolia (chain_id = 5373) - upgraded to upgrade 18 and activated isthmust and jovian; added also holocene timestamp for sepolia

## Checklist

- [ ] I have declared the chain at the appropriate [Superchain Level](../docs/glossary.md#superchain-level-and-rollup-stage).

- [x] I have checked `Allow edits from maintainers` on this PR.

topPRs.title: feat(proofs): update standard proof-game timing params
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Registry policy/reporting update: the standard proof-game timing parameters are updated to match the new proof-game timing defaults from the optimism contracts/deployer change.

Standard params now encode (mainnet + sepolia):

- `proof_maturity_delay_seconds = [43200, 43200]` (12 hours, was 7 days)
- `dispute_game_finality_delay_seconds = [43200, 43200]` (12 hours, was 3.5 days)
- `[proofs.permissioned] max_clock_duration = 561600` (6.5 days, was 3.5 days)

This keeps the 7 day total optimistic path: the portal proof-maturity air gap and the dispute-game finality air gap are both 12h, and the optimistic dispute-game max clock duration is 6.5 days.

## Changes

- `validation/standard/standard-config-params-mainnet.toml`
- `validation/standard/standard-config-params-sepolia.toml`
- `ops/internal/report/testdata/l1-report.json` — mock deployed chain `MaxClockDuration` updated `302400` -> `561600` so the report testdata represents a chain compliant with the new standard.
- `ops/internal/report/testdata/expected-comment.md` — mechanical golden-output update forced by the standard-param bump

## Validation

- `validation` module: `go test ./...` — PASS
- `ops/internal/report` `TestRenderComment` — PASS
